issue.title: [Bug] Responses→Chat：无 Claude 签名的 web_search_call 历史被静默删除（v0.1.3327）
issue.body:
## 问题摘要

Magpie **v0.1.3327** 将 Responses 会话转换为 Chat Completions 请求时，会静默删除普通 `web_search_call` 历史中的查询词和来源 URL；只有带符合条件的 Claude signed thinking 的搜索才走历史重建分支。

这与「搜索未执行」或「输出流重复拼接」不同：一次搜索可能已执行、结果也已用于当前请求，但客户端把搜索记录作为下一次 Responses 的 input 传回来时，这些现存历史信息被过滤，上游模型无法读取。

实际使用中遇到 agent 长会话反复搜索、反复说“复核”。**历史丢失已复现，但尚未通过修复前后对照证明它是所有重复生成的唯一原因。**

## 环境与范围

- macOS Apple Silicon，Magpie desktop/portable **0.1.3327**。
- 客户端 Codex，调用 `/v1/responses`。
- 自定义供应商同时配置 Chat/Responses URL；`baseAPI=responses`，目标单模型 API 设置为 `chat`。
- 实际链路：Codex → Magpie Responses→Chat → CPA + WorkBuddy 插件 → `blind-model-g`。
- 同一安装二进制的隔离副本 + 本机 mock Chat 上游也可复现，不需要 WorkBuddy、CPA 或真实账号。隔离副本没有改生产配置。
- 本报告是上述版本的实测。另只读检查了 main `c6bdc172a01e1eb8713c596e33e1ef703eb9b4ee`，同一删除分支仍存在；**没有声称对 main 二进制做过实测**。

## 最小合成复现

在隔离 portable 目录配置一个能记录 POST JSON 并返回标准 Chat SSE 的本机 mock 上游。供应商与设置示意（端口仅为例子）：

```json
{
  "providers": [{
    "id": "cpa",
    "name": "Synthetic local upstream",
    "key": "DUMMY_NOT_A_SECRET",
    "chat": "http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1",
    "responses": "http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1",
    "baseAPI": "responses",
    "codexAsSent": true,
    "nativeCompaction": true,
    "models": ["blind-model-g"],
    "pickedFrom": ["blind-model-g"]
  }],
  "groups": [],
  "order": ["cpa"]
}
```

```json
{"port":18081,"lan":false,"updateEvery":0,"modelAPIs":{"cpa/blind-model-g":"chat"}}
```

向隔离网关的 `/v1/responses` 提交下列合成请求；所有标记、链接均为诊断数据：

```json
{
  "model": "cpa/blind-model-g",
  "stream": true,
  "reasoning": {"effort":"high"},
  "tools": [{"type":"function","name":"noop","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{}}}],
  "input": [
    {"type":"message","role":"user","content":"Find the evidence and use the tool."},
    {"type":"reasoning","id":"rs_diag","summary":[{"type":"summary_text","text":"UNIQUE_THINKING_X718"}]},
    {"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"UNIQUE_ASSISTANT_X718"}]},
    {"type":"web_search_call","id":"ws_diag","status":"completed","action":{
      "type":"search",
      "query":"UNIQUE_SEARCH_QUERY_X718",
      "queries":["UNIQUE_SEARCH_QUERY_X718"],
      "sources":[{"type":"url","url":"https://example.invalid/UNIQUE_SEARCH_RESULT_X718"}]
    }},
    {"type":"function_call","id":"fc_diag","call_id":"call_diag","name":"noop","arguments":"{}"},
    {"type":"function_call_output","call_id":"call_diag","output":"UNIQUE_TOOL_RESULT_X718"},
    {"type":"message","role":"user","content":"Continue with the evidence already found."}
  ]
}
```

mock 上游记录到的 Chat `messages`：

```json
[
  {"role":"user","content":"Find the evidence and use the tool."},
  {"role":"assistant","content":"UNIQUE_ASSISTANT_X718","tool_calls":[{"id":"call_diag","type":"function","function":{"name":"noop","arguments":"{}"}}]},
  {"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"call_diag","content":"UNIQUE_TOOL_RESULT_X718"},
  {"role":"user","content":"Continue with the evidence already found."}
]
```

| 输入标记 | Chat 上游中是否存在 |
|---|---|
| 搜索 query | **否** |
| 搜索来源 URL | **否** |
| 普通 assistant 文本 | 是，1 次 |
| function 工具结果 | 是 |
| reasoning summary | 否；仅记录此现象，不主张对所有上游无条件回填 reasoning |

网关正常产生 `response.completed`，因此仅检查 HTTP 200 / 普通工具往返不能发现这个历史转换缺口。

## 真实链路的合成对照

在现有 `cpa/blind-model-g` 路由发送两组互不相同的随机诊断码，没有发送真实会话：

1. 码仅放在历史 `web_search_call.action.query/sources`，要求从历史读回，不搜索、不猜测：模型返回 **`MISSING`**。
2. 另一码放在普通 `function_call_output`，要求读回：模型准确返回该码。

两次均 HTTP 200、1 次 `response.completed`、流式正文 delta 与最终完整正文一致。这证明读取历史信息存在差异，**不把该对照冒充长会话重复问题的完整因果验证**。

## 代码定位

版本 tag 对应 commit：`b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8`。

- [responses.go L495–505](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8/internal/gateway/responses.go#L495-L505)：先解析 `web_search_call` 为内部 Search，保存 query 和来源 URL。
- [responses.go L611](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8/internal/gateway/responses.go#L611)：调用 `searchRoundsBack()`。
- [responses.go L639–644](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8/internal/gateway/responses.go#L639-L644)：非 assistant 或没有 `claudeSigned` 时直接删除 Search parts：

```go
if m.Role != "assistant" || !slices.ContainsFunc(m.Parts, claudeSigned) {
    m.Parts = slices.DeleteFunc(slices.Clone(m.Parts), isSearch)
    // ...
    continue
}
```

另一个需要区分的边界：`searchRounds()` 在当前请求中把搜索结果正文放入 `results[i].Text` 并回填给模型，但对客户端发出的 KSearch 主要携带 query / hits。参见 [search.go L1414–1437](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/b85475e57e8d9d576c8fe71dc2138f37457d11c8/internal/gateway/search.go#L1414-L1437)。因此“保住已有 query/URL”和“跨请求恢复完整搜索结果正文”是两个层次，后者可能需要额外的结果关联/存储机制；不能从 URL 凭空重建原始正文。

## 期望行为 / 建议验收

- 无 Claude signed thinking 的搜索历史，也应以协议合法的形式保留输入里已有的查询和来源；不要静默丢弃。
- 不生成缺少配对结果的孤立 tool call；不要破坏现有 Claude signed-thinking 路径。
- 如果需要完整结果正文，明确其保存与回放策略；若原请求没有该内容，不应编造。
- 回归测试不仅检查 parse 成功/200，还要断言 query、source URL 能到达最终 Chat 请求；加入跨请求历史回读与多轮搜索续接。
- native passthrough、普通 function 结果和不同上游的 reasoning 要求应分别处理。

## 相关但不同的讨论

- #2044：搜索记录从 Magpie **输出给客户端**；本报告关注记录作为下一次 **input 回传后被删除**。
- #4010：Claude signed thinking 跨搜索轮次的消息边界；本报告关注不满足该签名条件的普通搜索历史。
- #3206：工具声明在协议转换中丢失；本报告关注已经完成的工具历史。

未附 API Key、OAuth 凭证、个人域名、真实提示词、会话 ID 或原始私有日志。以上复现均为合成数据。

comments.body:
已提供最小修复：[fix/5713-search-history-chat](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/5713-search-history-chat)，提交 [40720189](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/407201898c58222693b858a14210fe0a2e33441d)，基于上游 `ed0ab567`。

无 Claude signed thinking 的 `web_search_call` 历史，现在把输入已提供的 query 和来源 URL 转成 assistant 文本传给 Chat 上游；不虚构完整搜索正文，不新增没有配对结果的工具调用。Claude 签名搜索轮次仍按已有路径重建，普通 function 结果和原生 Responses 直通保持原有行为。

回归通过真实 `/v1/responses` HTTP handler 到本机 Chat 上游，基线会缺失报告中的 query/URL；修复后两次请求均能读到各轮查询和来源且只出现一次，第二次请求回放前次实际响应，并保留函数调用/结果配对。签名重建和原生直通对照、相关 race、gateway vet、nogui build、格式检查通过；父会话也独立重跑了这组用例。vet 在最后一次仅修改测试之前运行。

只保留输入已有信息，未添加跨请求搜索正文存储，也未证明长会话重复生成的所有原因。没有运行真实账号、全量测试或跨平台验证。实现与审阅有 AI 辅助。

@yetone A client that keeps the searches of its turns as `web_search_call` items and sends them back with the next request loses them on the way to a Chat upstream: magpie parsed the query and the pages found out of the item, then dropped them again — only a search beside Claude's signed thinking went back — so the model read nothing of what had been searched, and on a long agent session it searched the same things again and told the user it had to double-check. Reported by @wudilyy999 (0.1.3327, Codex → magpie Responses→Chat → a chat upstream) with a synthetic reproduction on an isolated portable copy against a local mock upstream, and a real-chain read-back where a code kept only in the history's `web_search_call.action` comes back `MISSING` while one in a `function_call_output` comes back. **Root cause**: the parse keeps what the item holds — `web_search_call` with a query becomes an assistant message of `Search` parts, query and the URLs of its sources (`responses.go:495`) — but `searchRoundsBack` (`responses.go:639`), which puts magpie's own search rounds back for a Claude reply, takes the parts back out of every message that has no Claude signed thinking beside it (`DeleteFunc(isSearch)`), as it had always done. That branch is every plain search history's fate: the round-trip the item records survives, the search itself is gone. **The fix**: such a search goes as text — `Searched the web for: ` with `Pages found:` and the URLs — which is exactly what the client kept of it, in the assistant message where the search happened, the same words the signed-thinking path puts in a tool result today. No call is made up for it: no result of its own is kept to answer one (a strict upstream refuses a `tool_calls` with nothing answering it), and what the pages *said* was never kept, so none is written — the reporter's own boundary, kept. The round beside Claude's signed thinking is split into call and result as it was, byte for byte (its result text now comes from the one `searchSaid` helper, same words), and a request with no search in it never enters the function. One difference from the sibling that drops `web_search_call` items on a Responses relay (`withoutSearchCalls`, `responses.go:1004`): that one is left as it is — its input is relayed, not translated, the provider's own chat translation is what turned such an item into a call nothing answers (mxmllln's 400), and the summary requests it serves are told what was found by the reply that followed the search. A provider-side note on that path can be a turn of its own if you want one. A note on the landscape: skygunner's comment points at a branch of their own fixing the same report. I learned of it while clearing the issue before starting; I have not read its code, and the patch below is written from the issue's walk of `responses.go` alone — the shared shape (query and pages as text, no invented call) is the shape the deleted branch's own survivor, the signed-thinking path, already speaks.
patch: gateway: a web search a client sends back keeps its query and the pages it found on a chat upstream (#5713) — git am applies it as is; SHA-256 first 16 (of the .patch): 227e302639727ff6 It is the fork branch's native [`.patch`](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/commit/891efda52033f7052024da431235320ffc698e71.patch), 11.0 KB, three files, +120/−18.
**Branch with the commit**: [`fix/5713-web-search-call-history`](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/fix/5713-web-search-call-history) (head `891efda52033f7052024da431235320ffc698e71`), built on current `upstream/main` (`aa3d11d5b`, v0.1.3342's tip, fetched live before the work began); on a fresh checkout `git am` applies clean and the tree it lands is the branch's, tree hash for tree hash (`dfe700a8dfb1dc94`). | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | `TestSearchHistoryReachesAChatUpstream` (new) | red before the fix, pass after — red as the bug itself: the reporter's own request (search with query and source URL, a function call and its output, a user turn after) reaches the chat upstream with no query and no URL in any message | | `TestSearchWithoutClaudeThinkingGoesBackAsText` (rewrites `TestSearchWithoutClaudeThinkingStaysOut`, which pinned the drop) | red before, pass after — the query and the pages go as text, and no `ToolCall` or `Search` part is made up | | `TestResponsesSearchItemReplayed` (updated) | pass — a replayed search item keeps its query and pages in the turn instead of vanishing from it | | `TestClaudeThinkingAroundMagpieSearchGoesBackAsWritten` (the signed-thinking path, untouched) | pass, before and after — Bedrock's thinking check still satisfied, the round still split into call and result where Claude wrote them | | `TestUnsearchedConversationUnchanged`, `TestWithoutSearchCalls` (no search in the request) | pass — untouched | | Ablation | committed first, then only `responses.go` touched: the keep-branch made to `DeleteFunc` again turns `TestSearchHistoryReachesAChatUpstream`, `TestSearchWithoutClaudeThinkingGoesBackAsText` and `TestResponsesSearchItemReplayed` red while the signed-thinking test stays green; restored, all green, `git diff --stat` empty | | HTTP end-to-end on a built binary (isolated config, mock chat upstream, the issue's request verbatim) | before: query and URL `False` in what the upstream was sent (the reporter's table, reproduced); after: query `True`, URL `True`, assistant text and the function result `True`, one call with its answer, `response.completed` 200 | | `go test -tags nogui -count=1 ./internal/gateway/` (whole package) | ok (788.1s), zero failures | | `go vet ./internal/gateway/`, `gofmt -l` on the three changed files | clean, prints nothing | **Not verified**: the reporter's real chain (Codex against a signed-in CPA + WorkBuddy line, a real account behind it) — NOT-RUNNABLE here; the mock-upstream run above is the synthetic reproduction the issue itself stands on. The preset-red tests named in past rounds (`TestMothX`, `TestLaneLimitRoutes`, `TestProxyCheckSaysAProxyPassedBy`, …) live in other packages and did not come up in this one; the whole `gateway` package ran green with nothing to exclude. **Attribution**: analysis and patch written with AI assistance (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode); I have read the whole diff and the tests pass. Please keep the author (`ggbdpq`) or add `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq `. Generated-by: GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode)

Rebased onto current `upstream/main` (`7e5cebb86`, v0.1.3435): zero conflicts, and `aa3d11d5b..7e5cebb86` touches `internal/gateway/responses.go` not at all, so the patch is byte-for-byte the same fix on the new base. Branch: [`fix/5713-web-search-call-history`](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/fix/5713-web-search-call-history), head `4f60ecbf9`.

Verification on the new base:

- Tests re-run green: `TestResponsesSearchItemReplayed`, `TestSearchHistoryReachesAChatUpstream`, `TestSearchWithoutClaudeThinkingGoesBackAsText`, `TestSearchWithoutClaudeThinkingStaysOut`, `TestUnsearchedConversationUnchanged`, `TestWithoutSearchCalls`, `TestClaudeThinkingAroundMagpieSearchGoesBackAsWritten`.
- Ablation on the new base: the convert-to-text branch back to the silent delete → `TestSearchWithoutClaudeThinkingGoesBackAsText` and `TestSearchHistoryReachesAChatUpstream` red; restored → green.
- Sibling scan: `searchRoundsBack`'s callers and the `isSearch` family unchanged on the new base (no upstream commits in the file since the old base).
- Fresh patch `git am`s clean onto a tree at `7e5cebb86`; sha256[:16] `6d038bd4095df5d1`. Real-client replay stays NOT-RUNNABLE here, as posted (fixture replay covers the wire shape).
